caption: The drawing depicts a single, three-dimensional, cubic object positioned on a blank, off-white background. The object appears to be a chest or strongbox, illustrated in shades of dark brown with a reddish hue. The surfaces of the chest are adorned with an evenly spaced grid pattern, consisting of numerous protruding circular rivets, each of which is darker than the background of the chest itself. The chest has a panel pattern on its visible sides and top, which are shaded to suggest depth and structure. The object stands on four short, rounded legs or wheels, also colored a dark brown-red and shaded for dimensionality. No other objects or details are depicted in the drawing, and the composition centers the chest, leaving ample empty space around it.
